name: delivery-surface-canvas
description: A render surface for hosts with a canvas panel: a Mermaid diagram viewer and a Markdown document viewer, shown live beside the files they were written from. Implements one surface capability group — render (render_diagram, render_markdown) — with push/replace navigation and a history the Back button walks, as two Copilot canvases and nothing else. Tracks no runs and exports nothing; declares no dependency and names no engine.
